data.name: Khaleelah
data.gender_notes: Khaleelah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Khaleelah is a name that signifies a strong bond with Allah. It is derived from the Arabic word 'khalla', meaning 'friend' or 'companion'. The name Khaleelah carries the meaning “Friend of Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khaleelah usually hope their child will grow to embody friend of allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Khaleelah is considered a name that brings the bearer closer to Allah.
data.etymology: Khaleelah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Friend of Allah.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khaleelah total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_urdu.name: خلیله

in_hindi.name: खलीलह
